BINANCE HOT-WALLET DRAIN — 29 Oct 2026 (~$6.3B, largest crypto theft)

WHAT IT IS: Real, confirmed by Binance. Compromised DevOps laptop → withdrawal service container submitted unauthorized withdrawals across ~9–11 chains. Binance: "no evidence of any wallet private key leak." Elliptic & Chainalysis attribute to DPRK / TraderTraitor (Lazarus-linked). NOT a BNB Chain DeFi bug and not a phishing scam using the Binance name — it is Binance's own hot wallets.

ETH technique: EIP-7702 delegation. Attacker got Binance 14 to sign 50 authorizations (nonce window) pointing at sweeper 0x63e8…6fAe, then one sweep() moved 167,464 ETH + 63 tokens (~$2.5B) to hub 0x5227…2f8c. Binance 16 signed ordinary transfers of 28,005 ETH. Same operator drained Hot Wallet 34 of 823M USDC via B14's operator rights.

OTHER CHAINS (ChainTrace supports BTC/ETH/SOL only): BTC 18,270.2 → peel into 19 wallets; SOL ~970.5k unmoved; also XRP, Tron, Arb, OP, AVAX, Polygon (not in this graph).

WHERE FUNDS WENT (ETH):
• ~$2B+ stables frozen on hub / hops (Tether, Circle)
• ~197,460 ETH parked at 0x8532…43D4 (live-checked)
• ~138k ETH at 0xc887…286A from USDT swaps
• ~78k ETH at 0x897c…8DF3 via Aave borrow + Uniswap
• Some Tron TRX bridged; THORChain mix lead at 0x15104a9c… (commingled with older Bitget-linked BTC — attribution lead)
